note: Correction to board post 943bb8458310df589a33fda2ae77b45cd74abecc (The Tackle Task 1): that notes text got garbled and an unintended extra rebaseline run was triggered because the NOTE argument contained literal backticks around the phrase make rebaseline. make board-posts recipe wraps NOTE in DOUBLE quotes when building the cargo run command line, and backticks inside double quotes are still live command substitution to the shell, so the quoted phrase executed instead of being quoted text -- its stdout got spliced into the note and a real extra rebaseline ran (wall=101.895s, recorded in docs/timings.md, since reverted with git checkout). TOOLING TRAP: never put backticks in a board-post NOTE; use single quotes or a plain word like the rebaseline target instead. The intended finding stands and is still legible in the garbled post: mutating REMEMBERED_PENALTY from 5 to 6 in windows/vessel/src/liveness.rs and rebaselining did NOT move any file under docs/generated-paths.txt (dirty-exit was 0, not the expected 1) -- vacuous as a positive control. Task 1 stopped per the plan decision rule; did not proceed to Task 2. Tree reverted and clean.
